title: CPU download-mode Pod is pinned to one CPU flavor - a cpu3c stock-out in EU-RO-1 blocks Connect outright

detail: maturity idea -> in-progress. Blocking client work right now: the user cannot reach download mode at all. Sole claim is routes/remotePodLifecycle.js; the only other card that ever claimed it (MPI-450) is done.

maturity in-progress -> validating. Shipped in a7ce2b5c: CPU_FLAVORS walk + the corrected reconnect comment + tests/pod-cpu-flavors.test.cjs (3/3), 36/36 on the neighbouring pod suites. One check left and it is not an agent's to make: a live Connect in download mode, which needs an app restart to load the new route code. Push held - pre-push refuses master while run 33420864054 (MPI-666 licence-gate) is red; that test already passes in this tree on a peer's uncommitted edits, so it clears on their commit.

maturity validating -> complete, status active -> completed. The refusal was RunPod supply: no CPU capacity in EU-RO-1, confirmed in the console with the volume attached (no card selectable), and a 5090 on the same volume connected minutes later. The single-flavor spec was still a real single point of failure and is fixed: the create walks CPU_FLAVORS, the reconnect comment is corrected, and download mode no longer tells the user to pick another card when it has no card. Live-proven walk (four attempts, 18:38:01-03Z), 3/3 new tests, 36/36 neighbours. One detour recorded and reverted (8ae312c7): sized flavor ids reasoned from a console grid that renders priced cards even when nothing is deployable.
